definitions.joint_coordinate: mtp joint angle q (rad), positive = dorsiflexion, negative = plantarflexion
definitions.joint_velocity: qdot = dq/dt from the native Plant state

active_moment.definition: the net moment delivered by the m_left_mtp / m_right_mtp motor actuator, after the ACTUATION_AUTHORITY enforcement chain

passive_moment.definition: the FM-09 MTP passive engineering prior produced by the Plant: tau_passive = -k*(q - q_neutral) - c*qdot with k = 25 N*m/rad, c = 2 N*m*s/rad, q_neutral = 0.0 (V3_MTP_PASSIVE_STIFFNESS_NM_PER_RAD, V3_MTP_PASSIVE_DAMPING_NMS_PER_RAD, V3_MTP_NEUTRAL_RAD)
passive_moment.source: Plant; immutable; not a controller quantity
passive_moment.measurement: reconstructed from the Plant joint coordinate and velocity with the frozen prior, or read directly as the MTP component of the Plant passive generalized force; the two must agree to 1e-9 N*m in the deterministic checks

total_power.definition: tau_total * qdot with tau_total = tau_active + tau_passive
total_power.identity: P_total = P_active + P_passive exactly (no double counting: the passive moment is never folded into tau_active and vice versa)

active_work.definition: trapezoidal integral of P_active over native samples
active_work.sign_convention: positive = active moment does positive work on the toe (energy injection); negative = absorption

passive_work.definition: trapezoidal integral of P_passive over native samples

total_work.definition: trapezoidal integral of P_total over native samples

budgets_per_foot.budget_scope: the whole RES-85 control episode, per foot, from reset to the end of the RES-85 claim

supported_phase_active_authority.definition: the active MTP channel may regulate supported toe/forefoot mechanics only while legal plantar support is active for that foot
permitted_roles: contribute to the ankle-MTP rocker moment within the frozen ceilings
stabilise the foot segment during the countermovement and braking phases
prohibited_roles: replacement for the ankle plantarflexor channel
post-takeoff propulsion of the free foot
compensation for a zero-passive MTP Plant by unbounded active work

STAND.rationale: quiet supported stance; foot geometry maintenance

PROPULSION.rationale: supported push-off; explicitly bounded by the late-phase budget fraction

TAKEOFF_CONFIRM.rationale: support already lost; no toe-off energy injection is permitted during provisional flight

FLIGHT.rationale: no ground contact exists; the toe may only hold posture with zero net positive work budget

LANDING_PREP.rationale: RES-85 claim ends before landing optimisation

late_phase_restriction.definition: the PROPULSION phase and every later phase of the episode
late_phase_restriction.rule: at most half of the active positive work budget may be spent in the late phase; the remainder must already have been spent in earlier supported phases
late_phase_restriction.rationale: the takeoff energy must be dominated by the ankle/knee/hip channels; the MTP may only assist the rocker mechanism

zero_passive_sensitivity.case: build_zero_passive_model() (FM-09 k = c = 0, active channels present and zeroed initially)
zero_passive_sensitivity.rule: all MTP budgets in this authority are model-independent: the zero-passive Plant may not be compensated with additional active work beyond the same budgets
zero_passive_sensitivity.required_test: with the zero-passive Plant and the zero-active command, the controller must still reach its declared phase sequence or report the degradation honestly; the active channel must not be turned up to reproduce the passive energy release
zero_passive_sensitivity.anti_compensation_statement: An unbounded active-MTP energy injection that compensates a zero-passive MTP is a violation of this authority and fails the RES-85 negative-control gate.

anti_energy_injection_rule.statement: The active MTP channel may not inject net positive work beyond the declared budgets, and may never be the dominant positive-work source of the takeoff. The takeoff claim requires that the ankle channel's positive mechanical work strictly exceeds the active MTP positive work.
enforcement: AEI-1a: instantaneous |tau_active * qdot| <= power_ceiling_w at every native sample
AEI-1b: cumulative active positive work <= active_positive_work_budget_j at every native sample
AEI-1c: cumulative total positive work (active + passive) <= total_positive_work_budget_j at every native sample
AEI-1d: subsequent to exhausting either budget, the applied active MTP moment is gated to exactly 0.0 for the remainder of the episode (fail closed), and the gate event is recorded
AEI-1e: at TAKEOFF_CONFIRM entry and thereafter the applied active MTP moment is exactly 0.0
AEI-1f: the reported takeoff dominance check ankle_positive_work > active_mtp_positive_work must pass for the RES-85 flight claim
anti_energy_injection_rule.violation_handling: an AEI violation invalidates the RES-85 flight/performance claim (the episode may continue for telemetry but cannot be reported as a qualified launch)

double_counting_prohibitions: the passive moment is never included in tau_active
the active moment is never included in tau_passive
P_total is the sum of the two measured powers, never the power of a summed command after clipping
work integrals are computed per native sample from the two separate powers, never from an aggregate

energy_ledger_identity.statement: W_total = W_active + W_passive must hold to 1e-9 J in the deterministic checks for every recorded episode
energy_ledger_identity.auxiliary_identity: the change in the toe segment's mechanical energy over the episode equals W_total plus the remaining joint-moment work terms in the segment chain; this balance is a diagnostic, not a gate

external_evidence.use: measured external MTP moments 6.3-14.2 N*m bound the active channel magnitude
MTP role in take-off; windlass coupling and passive structure
intrinsic foot joint moment/power order in the propulsive configuration
